title: TRIPWIRE MINES ARE DRAWN
why: His feature 6 of 2026-10-12, the tripwire mine. You can now see your wires: a faint red line with a slow pulse and a small emitter at each end, dashed with a blinking amber light while it arms and a red light once it is live. They show above the darkness, so you and your teammate always see where your wires are. While you hold a mine on the trigger a dashed preview shows where the wire will go, and the label over your head reads RELEASE TO SET. The mine has its own belt icon.
now: Tripwire Mines are now drawn as a faint red wire with a preview while you hold one, and the mine has its own icon.

edits.replacement: ctx.fillText(p.cookKind==='trip'?'RELEASE TO SET':'RELEASE TO THROW',cs2.x,cs2.y-LH(14));   // v23.xx (feat1d): a Tripwire Mine is set, not thrown at something
